item.title: Kansas State’s Sam Hecht, VJ Payne Earn Invitations to 2026 NFL Combine
item.description: Following strong showings at the Panini Senior Bowl, Kansas State standouts Sam Hecht and VJ Payne have taken the next step toward their professional dreams.

item.title: Chief Justice appoints Rural Justice Initiative committee
item.description: TOPEKA - Chief Justice Eric Rosen signed an order appointing 18 members to the Rural Justice Initiative committee.

item.title: KDOT accepting applications for grants available through TA program
item.description: The Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT) is accepting applications for $32 million in available grant funding for construction projects through the Transportation Alternatives (TA) Program.

item.title: Big 12 to Debut Cutting-Edge LED Glass Court at 2026 Conference Tournament
item.description: The Big 12 Conference is set to unveil a bold new look for its postseason basketball showcase this March, introducing cutting-edge LED court technology at the 2026 Phillips 66 Big 12 Men’s and Women’s Basketball Tournaments at T-Mobile Center.

item.title: Royals acquire right-handed pitcher Mitch Spence
item.description: The Kansas City Royals added pitching depth to their staff on Tuesday, acquiring right-handed pitcher Mitch Spence from the Oakland Athletics in exchange for right-hander A.J. Causey.

item.title: KBCA releases weekly rankings
item.description: The Kansas Basketball Coaches Association has released their latest rankings for the season. Several area teams are in the rankings this week.

item.title: Lady Demons Rally Past Great Bend; Red Demons Fall
item.description: The Dodge City High School basketball teams split a Western Athletic Conference road trip Tuesday night, as the Lady Demons pulled out a gritty 47-41 victory over Great Bend, while the Red Demons dropped a 91-66 decision.
